premise: The meadow asks the wind where it's going; it's too busy to answer — blowing the fog away, spinning the leaves, tumbling Pinecone along and lifting Butterfly into the branches — until it lies down in the grass to rest, and then it whispers: everywhere, and back here tomorrow.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: the wind isn't a rival to be beaten, just a busy visitor with a secret.
lesson: Some questions are answered by waiting for a quiet moment.

en-US.title: Where the Wind Goes
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] One morning, the meadow was hidden in fog. Then — {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} WHOOSH! — {canvas:fog stop} the wind blew the fog away. {all:face surprised} [curious] "Wind, where are you going?" asked the meadow. But the wind was too busy to stop. {all:wobble 0.5} It tickled the grass. It ruffled the pond. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} It sent leaves spinning from the trees. {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling by, and the wind {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} tumbled her along. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] "Wheee!" {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Butterfly let it carry her {butterfly:go to branches right} up into the branches, where she {butterfly:live rest hold} folded her wings and held on. {acorn:enter} Acorn came walking up and {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} held on to her cap. At last the wind got tired. Whoo… shhh. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} It lay down in the grass to rest, and everything went still. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings. {acorn:live wish} Acorn made a wish: "Now tell us where you're going!" [whispers] And the wind whispered back, so softly only the grass could hear. {all:face happy} [happily] What did it say? "Everywhere… and back here tomorrow."

es-ES.title: ¿Adónde va el viento?
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] Una mañana, el prado amaneció escondido en la niebla. Y entonces… {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} ¡FIUUU! {canvas:fog stop} Llegó el viento y se llevó la niebla. {all:face surprised} [curious] —Viento, ¿adónde vas? —preguntó el prado. Pero el viento tenía demasiada prisa para pararse. {all:wobble 0.5} Le hizo cosquillas a la hierba. Rizó el agua de la charca. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Hizo bailar las hojas de los árboles. {pinecone:enter} Piña pasaba rodando, y el viento {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} se la llevó dando tumbos. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] —¡Yupiii! {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Mariposa se dejó llevar {butterfly:go to branches right} hasta las ramas, y allí {butterfly:live rest hold} plegó las alas y se agarró fuerte. {acorn:enter} Bellota llegó andando y {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} se sujetó el sombrerito. Por fin el viento se cansó. Fiuu… chsss. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} Se tumbó en la hierba a descansar, y todo se quedó quieto. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas. {acorn:live wish} Bellota pidió un deseo: —¡Ahora dinos adónde vas! [whispers] Y el viento contestó, tan bajito que solo lo oyó la hierba. {all:face happy} [happily] ¿Qué dijo? —A todas partes… y mañana, otra vez aquí.

ja-JP.title: かぜさん、どこへいくの？
ja-JP.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[softly]あるあさ、のはらは、きりにすっぽりかくれていました。そのとき——{canvas:wind 0.6}{sfx:wind}びゅうううん！——{canvas:fog stop}かぜが、きりをふきとばしました。{all:face surprised}[curious]「かぜさん、どこへいくの？」 とのはら。でも、かぜはいそがしくて、とまれません。{all:wobble 0.5}くさを、こちょこちょ。池に、さざなみ。{canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}木のはっぱを、くるくるまわします。{pinecone:enter}まつぼっくりがころがってくると、かぜは{pinecone:go to meadow right}{pinecone:spin}ころころ、ころころ、おしていきました。{pinecone:face happy}[giggles]「わーい！」 {butterfly:enter}{butterfly:face happy}チョウチョさんは、かぜにのって{butterfly:go to branches right}えだの上へ。{butterfly:live rest hold}はねをとじて、しっかりつかまりました。{acorn:enter}どんぐりは、てくてくやってきて、{acorn:face surprised}{acorn:live hold-cap}ぼうしをぎゅっとおさえました。やっと、かぜもくたびれて…ひゅう…すう…{canvas:wind stop}{canvas:leaves stop}くさのなかでひとやすみ。なにもかも、しずかになりました。{butterfly:live rest resume}チョウチョさんが、はねをひらきます。{acorn:live wish}どんぐりは、おねがい。「どこへいくのか、おしえてくれますように！」 [whispers]かぜは、くさにしかきこえないくらい、そうっとこたえました。{all:face happy}[happily]なんていったと思う？「どこへでも…そして、あしたもまたここへ」

de-DE.title: Wohin weht der Wind?
de-DE.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] Eines Morgens lag die Wiese versteckt im Nebel. Da – {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} WUSCH! – {canvas:fog stop} blies der Wind den Nebel fort. {all:face surprised} [curious] „Wind, wohin wehst du?“, fragte die Wiese. Aber der Wind hatte viel zu viel zu tun, um stehen zu bleiben. {all:wobble 0.5} Er kitzelte das Gras. Er kräuselte das Wasser im Teich. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Er ließ die Blätter von den Bäumen wirbeln. {pinecone:enter} Der Tannenzapfen kam vorbeigerollt, und der Wind {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} schubste ihn kullernd vor sich her. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] „Huiii!“ {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Der Schmetterling ließ sich vom Wind tragen, {butterfly:go to branches right} hinauf in die Äste, wo er {butterfly:live rest hold} die Flügel zusammenklappte und sich festhielt. {acorn:enter} Die Eichel kam angelaufen und {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} hielt ihr Hütchen fest. Endlich wurde der Wind müde. Huuu… schhh. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} Er legte sich ins Gras, um sich auszuruhen, und alles wurde still. {butterfly:live rest resume} Der Schmetterling öffnete seine Flügel. {acorn:live wish} Die Eichel wünschte sich etwas: „Jetzt sag uns, wohin du wehst!“ [whispers] Und der Wind flüsterte zurück, so leise, dass nur das Gras es hören konnte. {all:face happy} [happily] Was er wohl gesagt hat? „Überallhin… und morgen wieder hierher.“

fr-FR.title: Où va le vent ?
fr-FR.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] Un matin, le pré était caché dans le brouillard. Puis — {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} FOUUU ! — {canvas:fog stop} le vent a chassé le brouillard. {all:face surprised} [curious] « Vent, où vas-tu ? » a demandé le pré. Mais le vent était bien trop pressé pour s’arrêter. {all:wobble 0.5} Il a chatouillé l’herbe. Il a ridé la mare. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Il a fait tourbillonner les feuilles des arbres. {pinecone:enter} Pomme de pin passait en roulant, et le vent {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} l’a fait culbuter plus loin. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] « Youpiii ! » {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Papillon s’est laissé porter {butterfly:go to branches right} jusque dans les branches, où {butterfly:live rest hold} il a replié ses ailes pour bien s’accrocher. {acorn:enter} Gland est arrivé en trottinant et {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} a retenu son chapeau. Enfin, le vent s’est fatigué. Fouuu… chhh. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} Il s’est couché dans l’herbe pour se reposer, et tout est devenu calme. {butterfly:live rest resume} Papillon a ouvert ses ailes. {acorn:live wish} Gland a fait un vœu : « Maintenant, dis-nous où tu vas ! » [whispers] Et le vent a répondu tout bas, si bas que seule l’herbe a pu l’entendre. {all:face happy} [happily] Qu’est-ce qu’il a dit ? « Partout… et demain, je reviens ici. »

it-IT.title: Dove va il vento?
it-IT.text: {canvas:fog 0.6} [softly] Una mattina, il prato era nascosto nella nebbia. Poi — {canvas:wind 0.6} {sfx:wind} FIUUU! — {canvas:fog stop} il vento ha spazzato via la nebbia. {all:face surprised} [curious] «Vento, dove vai?» ha chiesto il prato. Ma il vento aveva troppo da fare per fermarsi. {all:wobble 0.5} Ha fatto il solletico all'erba. Ha increspato lo stagno. {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Ha fatto volteggiare le foglie degli alberi. {pinecone:enter} Pigna passava rotolando, e il vento {pinecone:go to meadow right} {pinecone:spin} l'ha portata via a capriole. {pinecone:face happy} [giggles] «Uiii!» {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} Farfalla si è lasciata portare {butterfly:go to branches right} su tra i rami, dove {butterfly:live rest hold} ha chiuso le ali e si è tenuta forte. {acorn:enter} Ghianda è arrivata a piedi e {acorn:face surprised} {acorn:live hold-cap} si è tenuta stretto il cappellino. Alla fine il vento si è stancato. Fiuu… sss. {canvas:wind stop} {canvas:leaves stop} Si è sdraiato nell'erba a riposare, e tutto è rimasto fermo. {butterfly:live rest resume} Farfalla ha aperto le ali. {acorn:live wish} Ghianda ha espresso un desiderio: «Adesso dicci dove vai!» [whispers] E il vento ha risposto, così piano che solo l'erba l'ha sentito. {all:face happy} [happily] Che cosa ha detto? «Dappertutto… e domani di nuovo qui.»

zh-TW.title: 風要去哪裡？
zh-TW.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[softly]一天早上，整片草地都躲在白白的霧裡。接著——{canvas:wind 0.6}{sfx:wind}呼——！{canvas:fog stop}風把霧吹走了。{all:face surprised}[curious]「風呀，你要去哪裡？」 草地問。可是風太忙了，忙得停不下來。{all:wobble 0.5}它搔搔小草的癢。它把池塘吹得皺皺的。{canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}它讓大樹上的葉子轉呀轉，轉呀轉地飛下來。{pinecone:enter}松果正好滾過來，風就{pinecone:go to meadow right}{pinecone:spin}推著她，骨碌碌，骨碌碌，一直滾。{pinecone:face happy}[giggles]「呀呼——！」 {butterfly:enter}{butterfly:face happy}蝴蝶讓風帶著牠，{butterfly:go to branches right}飛上了樹枝，{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀，緊緊抓住。{acorn:enter}橡實走了過來，{acorn:face surprised}{acorn:live hold-cap}趕快按住她的帽子。最後，風終於累了。呼……沙……{canvas:wind stop}{canvas:leaves stop}它躺在草地上休息，一切都安安靜靜的。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀。{acorn:live wish}橡實許了一個願：「現在告訴我們，你要去哪裡！」 [whispers]風輕輕地回答，小聲到只有小草聽得見。{all:face happy}[happily]它說了什麼呢？「到處去……明天，再回到這裡。」

zh-HK.title: 風去咗邊？
zh-HK.text: {canvas:fog 0.6}[softly]一天早上，整片草地都躲在大霧裏。忽然——{canvas:wind 0.6}{sfx:wind}呼——！{canvas:fog stop}風把霧吹走了。{all:face surprised}[curious]「風呀，你去邊呀？」 草地問。可是風忙得很，停也停不下來。{all:wobble 0.5}它搔搔小草，弄得小草好癢。它吹皺了池塘的水。{canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}它把樹上的葉子吹得團團轉。{pinecone:enter}松果剛好滾過來，風就{pinecone:go to meadow right}{pinecone:spin}推着她，碌呀碌，碌呀碌。{pinecone:face happy}[giggles]「嘩——好好玩呀！」 {butterfly:enter}{butterfly:face happy}蝴蝶讓風帶着牠，{butterfly:go to branches right}飛上了樹枝，{butterfly:live rest hold}合起翅膀，緊緊抓住。{acorn:enter}橡實走過來，{acorn:face surprised}{acorn:live hold-cap}連忙按住她的帽子。最後，風終於累了。呼……沙……{canvas:wind stop}{canvas:leaves stop}它躺在草地上休息，四周一下子靜了下來。{butterfly:live rest resume}蝴蝶張開翅膀。{acorn:live wish}橡實許了一個願：「而家話畀我哋知，你去邊呀！」 [whispers]風輕輕地回答，輕得只有小草聽得見。{all:face happy}[happily]它說了甚麼呢？「周圍去……聽日，再返嚟呢度。」
